source.original_title: 05/21/2026 - Tony Joseph x Harry Edmonds KL- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/21/2026 - Tony Joseph x Harry Edmonds KL- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Lost

setter.name: Kyla
setter.evidence: You spoke with Kyla, right? / Yep, I did.

prospect.name: Tony Joseph
prospect.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE (works there weekdays; family in Dubai and Sharjah)
prospect.occupation: Research engineer at a research institute; unpredictable shifts, sometimes starting at 4am and sometimes running to 2am
prospect.family_status: Married; wife lives in India. Brothers in Dubai and cousins in Sharjah, whom he travels to every weekend
prospect.training_background: Was fit in his early twenties and after college, then lost it to work and the COVID period. Has self-corrected from 92 kg to 84 kg over about eighteen months without setting any target, by adding habits. Currently walks 30-40 minutes two or three times a week and alternates 30-40 minute gym sessions, plus 6,000-8,000 steps a day moving around a large laboratory. Has used a kettlebell only for loaded carries and a few video-copied exercises, never on a routine for more than a week.
prospect.medical: Diagnosed with low vitamin D a few months before the call, which he attributes to sun avoidance in the local climate; says everything else came back normal. Erratic sleep — three or four properly slept nights a week, otherwise four to six hours. Attributes part of his post-2020 decline to 'the vaccine and things like that', which the rep did not respond to.

signals: Lost ground to a hard season — work taking over and the COVID period — and wants his earlier condition back: 'I was fit at a point of time when I was younger, maybe a few years after even college'

Counter-signal, and the reason confidence is low: he is not stuck, he is already succeeding on his own, down from 92 kg to 84 kg with no plan at all — 'I was just consistent in what I'm doing. And that gradually showed up'

Explicitly rejects the goal-and-commitment frame the programme is built on: 'the moment I put a date or a number or something like that, then it becomes a pressure. I don't want to do that.' A proposed label for this pattern is the_incrementalist

goals.text: Get from 84 kg toward 76 kg, or at least halfway to 78 kg, without setting it as a target
Make a lifestyle change that runs in parallel to work rather than competing with it
Add one or two 20-minute kettlebell sessions a week as a new default habit
Balance fitness, work and personal life at 30 — 'I need to step up my game'

pains.text: Unpredictable five-day work schedule, sometimes starting at 4am and sometimes finishing at 2am
Erratic sleep — only three or four properly slept nights a week
Weekend eating well over calories across every cuisine available while visiting family
Weight gain accumulated since 2020 as exercise fell away under work pressure
Weekly travel between Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Sharjah to see family, with a wife living in another country
Doubts his own ability to sustain a new commitment — 'Maybe a few months I'll do, then I'll get bored'

objections.raw_quote: this is where I'm also not sure if I'd be able to commit to something three to four weeks... it seems like something so quickly I'll have to do that I'm not sure that I'll be able to commit for a long time. Maybe a few months I'll do, then I'll get bored.
objections.rep_response: Ran one reframe — 'it comes to a case of prioritizing the time, right? Making the time so that you can get what you want' — and then disqualified him rather than working the objection

objections.raw_quote: after I registered, I noticed that the Instagram page had a lot of videos on how to do yourself and things like that. So I was slowly going to start again. something from amazon and start myself
objections.rep_response: Endorsed it — the rep had already directed him to exactly this route: 'do two kettlebell sessions a week. Follow the stuff on Trevor's Instagram or on his YouTube'

evidence: Rep disqualified on readiness before presenting anything: 'what I think you should do, I think you should do, try and do that yourself, right, because what I don't need to do is pay for the coaching and waste your money'
No price was mentioned at any point and no offer was described beyond 'three, four days a week of training'
Prospect accepted and chose the free route: 'I'll take that route maybe in a few months I'll get back to you'
Rep proposed a nurture path — two kettlebell sessions a week from Trevor's Instagram or YouTube, then a conversation if he becomes ready
Counter-evidence: the prospect never said no to the programme, because he was never asked; the disqualification was entirely rep-initiated
outcome.next_step: Prospect to buy a kettlebell and follow Trevor's free Instagram and YouTube content two sessions a week; rep said to get back in touch if he reaches a point of readiness. No date and no follow-up booked.

notable.note: Second disqualification of the batch made before the offer was ever presented or priced, and the second where the rep routed a setter-qualified inbound prospect to free content instead. The prospect's own method is demonstrably working — 92 kg to 84 kg in eighteen months with no plan — and that fact was never explored, even though it is both the strongest objection in the call and the strongest possible foundation for one. He also explicitly rejected the frame the whole playbook runs on ('the moment I put a date or a number, then it becomes a pressure'), and the script has no answer for that. Two calls in this batch ended with the rep sending the prospect to Instagram or a $200/month membership without a price ever being quoted; principals should know how often this is happening and whether it is policy.

quality.notes: Better than most in this batch but still swapped in places: the rep's questions at 00:07:31 ('What's your food like?') and 00:03:55 ('How was that conversation for you?') sit inside the prospect's blocks, and the closing three minutes from 00:18:40 run on as a single unlabelled block containing both speakers. Recording begins at 00:01:14 with roughly ninety seconds of audio troubleshooting and a gap to 00:03:04. Several ASR corruptions are present, including the word 'Fathom' inserted mid-sentence and a garbled passage around 00:12:16.
